terra.problem: Papa speaks as though he has personal experience of beaches outside his bakery. Things outside his world should come up as things people do, not as his own experiences.
Calling Babylon a different empire introduces a Bible fact from outside the passage without a reference.
The passage calls the yoke and burden Assyria's, but it does not say Assyria's soldiers put the burden on the LORD's people.
Calling Moab a nation introduces a Bible fact from outside the passage without a reference.
The passage says Assyria will be broken, not its king. It also does not mention an Assyrian king.
The statement that Assyria had a king is a Bible fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
Verse 26 says the plan is devised for the whole earth and the hand is stretched out over all the nations. It does not say the plan is for all the nations.
